detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Dissociative Disorders (Psychological Disorders):
Depersonalization/Derealization Disorder involves recurrent episodes where the individual feels like an outside observer of their own body/thoughts (depersonalization) or experiences external surroundings as dreamlike, distant, or foggy (derealization).
